sections.markdown:
## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: traffic signs, signals and pavement markings
Knowledge facts: part C holds 47 fact blocks (sec07-F01 onward) from physical pages 49 to 57; part C2 holds 37 confusable and continuation blocks (sec07-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the July 1, 2022 content date, the multiple-choice format and its four roughly equal topic areas, the vision standard and the one-day retake wait from physical pages 3, 35 and 36; question count, passing score and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- TN-SIGN-A-EXAM — question count, passing score and time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- TN-SIGN-A-FRESH — content dated July 1, 2022; current edition and liveness unconfirmed (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- TN-SIGN-D-SCHOOL — school sign color: yellow versus fluorescent yellow-green (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- TN-SIGN-D-SHAPE — regulatory signs described as always rectangular despite octagon and triangle regulatory signs (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- TN-SIGN-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- TN-SIGN-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: sign designs change as Tennessee updates to the federal uniform standards, and the reference marker cities and spacing (for example sec07-R28, sec07-R33) can change; refresh them from official Tennessee sources.

corpus_stability.reason: The Tennessee Comprehensive Driver License Manual says its content is current as of July 1, 2022 and its back cover carries one March 2025 print authorization; nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year, but the content date is old, so freshness is held as debt rather than assumed.
